quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation TDnet: Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter of (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Consolidated results for the first half of fiscal year 2026 (April 1 - September 30, 2026; FY2026 2Q): net sales JPY 257,058 million (+32.1% YoY), operating income JPY 116,639 million (+47.9%), ordinary income JPY 114,437 million (+44.0%) and net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 80,366 million (+43.7%), against JPY 194,537 million, 78,871 million, 79,465 million and 55,913 million a year earlier; net income per share JPY 740.84 (prior year JPY 515.70). Total assets JPY 824,584 million and equity ratio 76.1% at September 30, 2026 (78.9% at March 31, 2026). Subsidiary DISCO HI-TEC EUROPE GmbH decided to demolish existing buildings in Bavaria, Germany and construct a new building (impairment loss JPY 636 million on the buildings).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 257,058 million (+32.1%); operating income JPY 116,639 million (+47.9%)
